exceptions.reason: vLLM documentation rate limits automated scrapers. Still live: re-probed 2026-09-10 with the checker's own user agent, headers, 3-attempt retry and concurrency 12, over both referenced URLs. A 429 appeared in all three probe rounds, and in one round https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/serving/openai_compatible_server/ returned 429 on all three attempts, so the retry does not absorb it.

The OpenAI help centre requires bot verification, so an automated request is refused rather than served. Still live: re-probed 2026-09-10 with the checker's own request shape and answered 403 on 9 of 9 attempts across three rounds, with no successful fetch. The article is a primary source for the ChatGPT Projects material and is correct for a reader in a browser, so replacing it with a secondary source that a checker can fetch would make the citation worse.

OpenAI corporate pages block automated GET requests. Still live: re-probed 2026-09-10 with the checker's own request shape over all four referenced URLs and every one answered 403 on all three attempts, 36 of 36, with no successful fetch. These are primary-source citations for the agent-building and Codex material, so they are kept rather than swapped for a fetchable secondary source.

Hugging Face documentation rate limits concurrent CI link checks and can return a server error under that load. Both codes were observed from CI rather than from a workstation: the 500 on 2026-08-31, and the 429 when this entry was widened on 2026-09-01 (d5bd730) because CI itself was being limited. Re-probing on 2026-09-10 returned 200 on the first attempt for all 8 referenced URLs in all three rounds, 24 of 24 - but from a workstation address, which cannot show what the CI runner sees, so that is not evidence either code has stopped. Renewed unchanged for one cycle on that basis; this is the weakest of the four, because the only evidence for it is nine days old and second-hand. If the next review finds it still unexercised in CI, delete it rather than renewing again.
